summary: Frontend-only regression for 9 refinements on DukanSaathi demo PWA. Executed Playwright flows against public URL after localStorage.clear() + demo login. 11 of 12 targeted checks PASS; 1 seed-data bug found (invoice i1 still uses old slash format).

ui_bugs.issue: Seed invoice i1 is still 'GST/2026/0001' (old slash format). Review requires all seed invoices to be GST20260001..GST20260005 (no separators). All other seeds (i2..i5) already use new format. Verified in localStorage after fresh seed and in source file line 25.

test_results.invoice_number_format_new_bill_and_retur: PASS — Created GST20260006 (sale) and RET20260007 (return); both match ^(GST|INV|RET)\d{4}\d{4}$
test_results.number_inputs_full_clear: PASS — item-qty-0 default '1', Ctrl+A+Delete -> '', typing '2abc' -> '2'. Also verified on pf-showroomQty ('40' -> '', typing 'abc12.3xy' -> '12.3').
test_results.caret_at_end_on_focus: PASS — selectionStart===selectionEnd===value.length observed on item-qty-0 and pf-showroomQty.
test_results.new_bill_preview_vs_confirm: PASS — preview-bill-btn calls window.open (1), keeps items (items_left=1), creates NO invoice; confirm-save-btn opens PDF again, RESETS form (items=0), creates invoice GST20260006.
test_results.returns_preview_vs_confirm: PASS — preview-return-btn opens PDF, keeps return-detail visible, does NOT create return; submit-return-btn opens PDF, hides return-detail (reset), creates RET20260007.
test_results.returns_invoice_picker_search_select: PASS — On focus, 6 sale invoice options listed (invoice-option-<id>). Typing 'Ashok' filters to 3. Clicking invoice-option-i5 loads return-detail with that bill's items.
test_results.stock_list_pieces_breakdown: PASS — p1 initial: show-qty-p1='Show 40b', godown-qty-p1='Godown 120b', total-pieces-p1='Total 640 pc'.
test_results.stock_sync_640_to_629_on_sale: PASS — After Confirm & Save of 2 box + 3 pcs (=11 pcs) for p1: total-pieces-p1='Total 629 pc'. Showroom-first deduction verified: Show 37b +1pc, Godown 120b (149+480=629).
test_results.return_restores_stock: PASS — After returning 1 box of p1 from GST20260005: total 629 -> 633 pc (+4 pcs).
test_results.dashboard_stat_udhari_navigation: PASS — Clicking stat-udhari navigates to /customers?tab=udhari with Udhari tab active.
test_results.udhari_tab_first_customers_second: PASS — DOM order: tab-udhari precedes tab-customers. Default tab on /customers is Udhari.
test_results.unique_customer_names_and_required: PASS — Empty name -> error toast 'Customer ka naam daaliye', no create. Duplicate 'Ashok Kumar' -> error toast 'Ye naam pehle se hai — har customer ka naam unique hona chahiye', still exactly 1 Ashok Kumar in customers.
test_results.pdf_text_changes: NOT VERIFIABLE IN HEADLESS (per instructions). Source review of /app/frontend/src/services/billPdf.js confirms: no 'All amounts are in Indian Rupees.' string present (grep found none); return title is 'RETURN INVOICE' (line 41).

action_items: Fix seed.js line 25: change invoice i1 invoiceNo from 'GST/2026/0001' to 'GST20260001' to match the new no-separator seed format described in the review request.
critical_code_review_comments: Seed invoice i1 uses old slash format while i2..i5 use new format — inconsistency likely missed during refactor of genInvoiceNo.
PDF preview correctly delegates to window.open(bloburl) via emit() 'newtab' mode — verified 1 call per Preview and additional call per Save, matching spec.

AppContext.addCustomer dedupes by name silently (returns existing) — page-level saveCustomer in Customers.jsx correctly enforces the error toast for duplicates before calling it, so unique-name UX is intact.
seed_data_creation: Ran localStorage.clear() + reload before every login to load fresh seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 9 new refinements verified working end-to-end. Only outstanding item is a minor seed data typo (i1 invoice number). Public URL: https://dukan-voice-billing.preview.emergentagent.com. Routes: /bill (NewBill), /returns, /inventory, /customers, /history. LocalStorage key: dukansaathi_demo-shop (single JSON blob with products/customers/invoices/returns/expenses/meta).
rca of the issue: seed.js line 25 was not updated when the invoice-number format was migrated to `${prefix}${year}${seq}`; the other four seed invoices (i2..i5) were converted but i1 was skipped.
